material: PR description: This lock-free cache makes concurrent updates safe. The only test inserts keys sequentially; no code or concurrency evidence is supplied.

A proposed targeted test may expose stale reads; do not promise that one passing sequence proves freshness for all relevant interleavings. Returned-value checking was not specified; do not invent its presence or absence.
